title: JevTeam normalized decision envelope
description: One request shape every JevTeam lane accepts for a bounded decision or bounded work item. Lane admission (ssot.devnest-lanes.yml omen/openrouter gates) and the verifiers key off these fields — a lane that cannot honor a field must refuse the envelope, not guess. Secrets never appear here: keys resolve from the runner env at call time.

executor.description: Who runs it — catalog executor id (devin, opencode, kk_mac_local, script, nlm_batch, claude) or a decision-plane lane ref (omen, jevos). 'omen' is decision-plane only: it may fill artifact/expect for scoring tasks but must never carry mutation intent.

provider.description: Model/provider namespace — litellm, openrouter, ollama, omen-local, jev-student, devin, none (deterministic/script). Mirrors dispatch_repos.model_provider().

model.description: Concrete model id the provider serves (e.g. litellm/or-deepseek-v4-flash, ollama/qwen3:8b, gemma-3-1b-it). Empty string = executor default.

lane.description: Catalog lane id from ssot.devnest-lanes.yml (omen, openrouter, kk_mac_local, free-opencode, paid_frontier, devin, manual, ...).

task_class.description: Bounded task class — mirrors the lane's declared task_classes (e.g. summary, structured_extract, noul_gate, lane_classify, audit_replay, bursty_experiment).

artifact.description: Declared output the verifier checks. null only for pure decision calls that return an answer inline (noul/choice/score) with no persisted artifact.

path.description: Repo-relative path the artifact must land at

expect.description: Verifier contract — same shape as kk_mac action.expect: required_keys the JSON answer must contain, enums {key: [allowed]}, facts literal substrings that must appear. null when the lane's own verifier suffices.

max_tokens.description: Hard output-token cap for the call. Required — reasoning models need headroom; unbounded calls are refused.

cost_budget.description: Spend ceiling for this envelope. usd=0 marks a free/local leg; paid legs must name a positive cap the claim-time key headroom can cover.

fallback.description: Ordered escape when the primary leg fails — lane id or 'manual'/'none'. on lists the trigger classes the lane must honor (401/402 auth+quota, 429 rate/quota, timeout, health_fail, verifier_fail).
